messages:
ian_support: incoming from acct acme-corp, ticket #12345 — CSV export only contains header row and the last row is cut off mid-cell. customer says the field contains newlines and long freeform text. attached screenshot and bytes size (0.5KB).

alex_support: thanks — can you paste the export job id + request_id? browser/os? did they try 'All time' or any other filter?

ian_support: job_id=98765, request_id=rq_0a1b2c3d, Chrome 117 on macOS Ventura. Filter: segmentation user_type=beta + date range last 30d. They say when they remove the segment filter the CSV looks normal.

santiago_eng: quick check: I pulled the job trace. log snippet: `{"job_id":"98765","status":"completed","upload_size":512,"s3_key":"exports/98765.csv"}`. Upload size 512 bytes — too small. Looks like writer closed early.

infra-bot: deploy event: export-service v2.3.4 rolled at 2026-03-17T10:12:05Z to prod.

santiago_eng: putting hypothesis: streaming CSV writer + prefix flush bug. If a field contains a literal newline and we stream chunks with a byte-limit, the writer's state machine might close the multipart upload prematurely. This would create a truncated file and still mark job as completed.

alex_support: can we repro locally? any quick repro steps to tell customer so they can continue working?

santiago_eng: repro steps for eng: 1) seed DB with a row where message contains multiple newlines and long text (~10k chars). 2) call /exports?segment=user_type=beta&streaming=true&format=csv 3) observe multipart upload with part sizes, check final object length. On my laptop I can reproduce with streaming chunk=256 bytes.

li_product: is this a regression tied to the v2.3.4 deploy? any customers affected other than acme-corp?

ian_support: three tickets in last 2 hours with same symptom (header-only or truncated last row) from different accounts in EU region. All reported after 10:15 UTC.

santiago_eng: mitigation: re-run job with `streaming=false` (server will buffer before upload) or set format=json for now. Quick internal hotfix: bump chunk flush boundary so we don't close on mid-cell; I'll open PR. For customers we can re-run affected job IDs and force non-streaming.

alex_support: telling customer the workaround now. can you give me a curl example to re-run with streaming disabled?

santiago_eng: curl example (use with their auth token):
```
curl -X POST "https://api.redwood.example/v1/exports" \ 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \ 
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ 
  -d '{"range":"30d","segment":"user_type=beta","format":"csv","streaming":false}'
```
I'll also attach a note: please re-download after I kick the job.

li_product: please collect full list of affected job_ids + accounts and mark P1. we need rollback plan if PR doesn't land quick.

ian_support: collecting job ids now, I'll dump them here when done.

deploy-bot: rollback option available: export-service v2.3.3 image still in registry.

santiago_eng: opened ENG-EXPORTS-412 with the bug repro, log traces, and a tentative fix. labeling eng-infra and eng-runtime. ETA for patch in staging: 2 hours.

ian_support: thanks — I'll update the customers with workaround and ETA.

alex_support: adding note to ticket: workaround + expected fix window. :thumbsup:

santiago_eng: one more diagnostic tip: if you see upload_size < 2KB but row count expected >10, that's a red flag. also check CloudTrail S3 CompleteMultipartUpload events to confirm finalization timestamp.

ian_support: got it — will include those logs in the escalation bundle.

li_product: keep me posted before code goes to prod so we can pre-announce to enterprise customers.

ian_support: will do.
